Hi there,

I'm Anirudh Bagla, a student at Harvard Business School. I noticed you added evening telehealth hours this year and wanted to reach out. Given your focus on adult chronic care, I'd value your perspective.

My co-founder and I are exploring a way for independent practices like Beacon Hill Internal Medicine to give GLP-1 patients complete care, side-effect management, nutrition and exercise, through a shared team of nutritionists and coaches, with the insurance billing handled. Large health systems already do this; we want to know if it would work for independent practices.

We're not selling anything. Would you have 30 minutes on Fri 10/23 2:00pm or Tue 10/27 10:00am, by phone or in person at your practice?

Thank you,
